text:
liya: quick personal update — accepted a promotion to Senior PM 🎉 and also said YES this weekend 💍. i know, wild. planning a tiny in-office 'three good things' drop-by: Friday 3–3:30pm in the kitchen (sushi + small confetti celebration). no pressure, just come say hi!

omar: wait WHAT. double congrats!!! :tada: :heart_eyes: need deets — sushi pls.

kevin: omg liya congrats!!! can we BYO confetti cannon? (kidding... maybe) :joy:

jen-people-ops: Liya!!! HUGE. People Ops will cover a small cake (vegan option available) and help with cleanup. also i can create a calendar invite — want me to add a short RSVP + +1 field?

liya: thanks jen!! please do add the invite. tiny favor — i'm skipping cards and collecting plant recs / small houseplants instead (moving into a new place). if people want to bring a little plant or a rec, that would be the best. i'll paste a very short 'plant registry' link in a sec. :seedling:

shrifa: what kind of plants? i'm terrible at keeping things alive. low-maintenance recs pls.

maya: snake plant or pothos are foolproof. i'll bring a tiny pothos.

omar: RSVP with emoji? :tada: i'm in. :sushi: for snacks.

kevin: :tada: for sure. can bring mochi. also congrats again liya.

calendar-bot: Event created — "Liya's Three Good Things" Friday 3:00 PM–3:30 PM (Kitchen). Invite sent by jen-people-ops.

jen-people-ops: invite sent and i added a note to indicate cake, vegan option, and plant registry link. i also added a 'quiet confetti' request so facilities knows cleanup.

liya: omg you all are the best. if you can't make it but want to drop a plant rec, leave it here or DM me. see you Friday (or on slack)! 💜
